title: Business Hours
text: Our business operates Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. We are closed on weekends and major holidays. For urgent matters outside business hours, please leave a message and we'll get back to you on the next business day.

title: Refund Policy
text: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all products. If you're not satisfied with your purchase, you can request a full refund within 30 days of the purchase date. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days. To initiate a refund, please contact our support team with your order number.

title: Shipping Information
text: We offer free standard shipping on orders over $50. Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping is available for an additional fee and takes 2-3 business days. International shipping is available to select countries and takes 10-15 business days.

title: Product Returns
text: Items can be returned within 30 days of purchase for a full refund or exchange. Items must be in original condition with tags attached. To return an item, obtain a return authorization number from our support team. Free return shipping is provided for defective items.

title: Account Management
text: You can manage your account at any time by logging into our website. From your account dashboard, you can update your profile information, change your password, view order history, and manage saved payment methods. If you need to delete your account, please contact our support team.

title: Payment Methods
text: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. All transactions are encrypted and secure. We do not store your full credit card information on our servers.

title: Technical Support
text: Our technical support team is available Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. You can reach us via phone, email, or live chat. For common technical issues, please check our knowledge base and FAQ section on our website. We typically respond to email inquiries within 24 hours.

title: Product Warranty
text: All products come with a standard 1-year warranty covering manufacturing defects. Extended warranty options are available for purchase at checkout. The warranty does not cover damage from misuse, accidents, or normal wear and tear. To file a warranty claim, contact our support team with proof of purchase.

title: Privacy Policy
text: We take your privacy seriously and are committed to protecting your personal information. We collect only the information necessary to process your orders and provide customer service. We never sell your information to third parties. You can request a copy of your data or request deletion at any time.

title: Loyalty Program
text: Join our loyalty program to earn points on every purchase. Earn 1 point for every dollar spent. Redeem points for discounts on future purchases. Members also get early access to sales, exclusive offers, and free shipping on all orders. Sign up is free and takes just a minute.
